name: rynke-points
description: Strava integration for Team Rynkeby Hamburg: collects riders' activities (with consent), detects event participation, and awards gamified Rynke Points.
author: Sascha Steffen <sascha.steffen@itemis.de>

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply rynke-points --local --persist-to .wrangler/fake-state && env -u STRAVA_CLIENT_ID -u STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET -u STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN -u TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY -u SESSION_SIGNING_KEY wrangler dev dev/worker.ts --env-file dev/fake.env --var RYNKE_FAKE_STRAVA:local-only --persist-to .wrangler/fake-state --live-reload --test-scheduled
